task.title: Issue target-scoped administrator recovery permits
task.input: M3-T3 target-scoped fresh grants/current authorization; section 09/10 15-minute permit and audit protocol.
task.output: AdminRecoveryPermit; POST /api/admin/account/recovery-authorizations and its compatible alias POST /api/admin/users/[id]/reset-2fa.
task.accept: 1) Caller/wiring point: real ADMIN handler -> recovery-authorizations. Current password plus a new TOTP obtains RECOVERY_AUTHORIZE bound to another target before a 15-minute permit is issued. The target cannot be self. Old bodyless direct reset, session-only requests, visitor email requests, SALES, and EDITOR all reject without changing target factors (E-13). 2) The permit is a random 256-bit value, stored only as a hash and returned once. Grant consumption and target/source/reason audit commit together. Reusing a grant issues no second permit; logs contain no plaintext permit, and response loss does not automatically issue another. An ordinary passwordless session cannot use this path to omit the current password (E-73, E-74, E-75).
